description: India: SEBI CSCRF 'Regulatory Data' must stay within India (readable, accessible to SEBI/CERT-In); RBI and DPDP expectations alike. Confirm against your own legal advice.
sources: SEBI CSCRF PR.DS guidelines (data localisation) and Annexure-J (cloud)

zones_help.local: this machine or your own LAN/on-prem (the burrow, an Ollama on your network)
zones_help.in: an in-country cloud region you have attested (MeitY-empanelled offering, STQC-audited)
zones_help.global: anywhere else - every public AI API unless you know where it runs

cloud.attestation_note: SEBI CSCRF Annexure-J: hosted services must be at least the standard of MeitY-empanelled CSP offerings, audited by an STQC-empanelled auditor; keep a copy of data in India if hosted abroad. SecuRAX cannot verify this: it records YOUR evidence reference.
